grammarName.en: Reported speech (she said she was tired)
grammarName.ru: Косвенная речь (she said she was tired)

scenario: Kate organises a karaoke night as a team-building — 'we are one big family!' The next morning everyone retells what people said the night before, so the whole episode is reported speech. Before the party, Den told everyone he couldn't sing and wouldn't come. Alex joked that Den had a beautiful voice. Valery said he was retiring on Friday, so he didn't need to sing. Pol said singing was good for your health. Peter, the shy junior, said he didn't know any of the words. David, the US client, joined by video call and said he loved karaoke. The twist: Den actually came and sang brilliantly — everyone now says Den was the star of the night. Warm, gentle humour; short B1 sentences. Use plenty of natural reported speech (said/told, that-clauses, backshift): 'Kate said the party would be fun', 'Den told us he couldn't sing', 'Alex said Den had a great voice', 'Pol said singing was good for you'.
